title: Playboy Magazine October 1992 Girls of the Big East Tiffany Sloan
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, October 1992 -- "Hanging Out With the Girls of the Big East," Miss October Tiffany Sloan.

Condition: pre-owned, complete issue with normal signs of age and storage, including a couple of small stain marks on the lower-left front cover (see photo). Please review photos carefully for exact condition.
